lore.common: Rolls straight into the drain the moment someone kicks it gently.
lore.uncommon: Disappears into the same hedge every single game.
lore.rare: Always bounces towards the most breakable thing in sight, even if it has to go round a corner to find it.
lore.epic: Went over next door's fence so often that the grandad there kept it and started a team. They are top of the league.
lore.legendary: Was kicked so high at a school match that it came down a week later, covered in frost, with a seagull still sitting on it.

lore.common: Bops the ceiling light every time it's dropped on the kitchen floor.
lore.uncommon: Always ends up under the fridge with the dust and lost peas.
lore.rare: Bounces a little higher every time it lands, so a ball dropped at breakfast is still being chased at lunch.
lore.epic: Ricocheted round the kitchen for ten minutes and knocked every fridge magnet into alphabetical order.
lore.legendary: Was dropped from a tower and bounced back up to the top floor, where it waited politely.

lore.common: Always says ask again later when you need an answer right now.
lore.uncommon: Shows its answer in a cloudy bubble that takes ages to float up.
lore.rare: Reads the question on your face before you ask it, then answers 'not telling' just to watch you squirm.
lore.epic: Said no to every single question at a sleepover, so a whole room of children stayed up until dawn trying to get one yes.
lore.legendary: Said yes to the question will it snow tomorrow, and the next day there was a snowman on every lawn.

lore.common: Rolls across the floor at night and wakes the whole house.
lore.uncommon: Gets lost under the skirting board the moment the game starts.
lore.rare: Rolls uphill whenever anyone tries to tidy it away, and it always reaches the top of the stairs first.
lore.epic: Escaped the marble run during assembly, and the head teacher slid all the way to the stage on it, still talking.
lore.legendary: Was flicked so hard in the playground that it went all the way round the world and hit its owner's other marble from behind.

lore.common: Gets squeezed so hard that it looks like it's pulling a face.
lore.uncommon: Takes a little longer to puff back up every day, as if it is sulking about being squeezed.
lore.rare: Soaks up the grumpiness of whoever squeezes it, then grumbles about it all night in the drawer.
lore.epic: Absorbed a whole office's stress on deadline day, swelled to the size of a sofa and had to be rolled out of the fire door.
lore.legendary: Took the stress of a whole country on one terrible Monday, went flat as a pancake, and Tuesday was lovely for everybody.

lore.common: Floats up to the ceiling so the string is just out of reach.
lore.uncommon: Pops with a bang that makes everyone at the party scream.
lore.rare: Rubs itself on jumpers to build up static, then zaps the birthday child right on the nose.
lore.epic: Was tied to the shopping trolley and lifted it off the car park, so Mum had to walk it home like a kite.
lore.legendary: Floated all the way round the world and drifted back in through the same window a year later, just in time for cake.

lore.common: Ends up in every corner of the house for months.
lore.uncommon: Hides in your hair long after the party is over.
lore.rare: Doubles when swept, so every dustpan comes back with more confetti than the floor had.
lore.epic: Went off a week early inside a birthday card, and the post office is still sparkling at Easter.
lore.legendary: Was thrown so high at one wedding that it is still coming down, and the couple's grandchildren keep finding bits in their hair.

lore.common: Swings with all its might and hits nothing but air.
lore.uncommon: Gives a splinter to anyone holding it wrong.
lore.rare: Makes every ball it hits buzz like a wasp, so the fielders run away instead of trying to catch it.
lore.epic: Smashed a ball over the park fence into the duck pond, and the ducks have been using it as a football ever since.
lore.legendary: Hit a ball so far that it landed in the next town's park and won their game too.

lore.common: Spins round the rim and pops back out every time.
lore.uncommon: Bounces so loudly in the hallway that the neighbours bang on the ceiling.
lore.rare: Swerves away from the hoop at the last second whenever its owner's friends are watching.
lore.epic: Was slam-dunked so hard that it went through the court floor and came up in the school kitchen, inside the custard.
lore.legendary: Went in from so far away that the scoreboard ran out of numbers and gave the point to the ball.

lore.common: Gets coloured outside every line.
lore.uncommon: Has a crayon snapped in its spine from the last time.
lore.rare: Colours in its own pages overnight, always in the wrong colours: purple grass, green faces and a tartan sky.
lore.epic: Leaked its outlines onto the kitchen table, so the family now eats dinner off a colouring-in of a farm.
lore.legendary: Its unfinished drawings stepped off the page one rainy day, and a half-coloured giraffe ate the curtains.

lore.common: Dribbles milk down the baby's chin every time.
lore.uncommon: Gets thrown out of the pram onto the pavement.
lore.rare: Warms itself to exactly the right temperature, but only once everyone in the house is awake.
lore.epic: Squirted milk across the kitchen in one long arc and filled the cat's bowl from the high chair.
lore.legendary: Got a baby to sleep so well that she slept through her own first birthday party, and the guests ate the cake in whispers.

lore.common: Squirts water up your nose when you squeeze it too hard.
lore.uncommon: Has its lid chewed by its owner during every match.
lore.rare: Squirts sideways whenever anyone but its owner drinks from it, so nobody else has ever had a sip.
lore.epic: Squirted every player on the team at half-time, and the coach got soaked too.
lore.legendary: Was squeezed so hard on the hottest sports day ever that it watered the whole pitch, and the grass came up green by the final whistle.

lore.common: Has every crayon snapped in half within a week.
lore.uncommon: Is always missing the one colour you need.
lore.rare: Swaps the paper wrappers at night, so the crayon labelled blue always draws orange.
lore.epic: Was left with a toddler for five minutes, and the dog came out of the bedroom striped like a tiger.
lore.legendary: Had every colour in the world in it, including one nobody had a name for.

lore.common: Pops out so suddenly that everyone drops what they're holding.
lore.uncommon: Needs winding round and round while it plays a tune.
lore.rare: Pops out at the worst possible moment, always mid-sip or mid-sneeze, and never when it has just been wound.
lore.epic: Popped out so high at a birthday party that it stuck in the ceiling light and nodded at the guests all evening.
lore.legendary: Popped out once with such a spring that it bounced to the top of the town clock, and now jumps out every hour on the hour.

lore.common: Plays the same tune over and over until everyone is humming it.
lore.uncommon: Has to be wound up every five minutes.
lore.rare: Speeds up its tune whenever someone dances to it, until the little dancer on top is spinning like a top.
lore.epic: Was wound up in a busy shop, and the whole queue slowed down and waltzed to the till.
lore.legendary: Played its tune so beautifully that the tiny dancer climbed out of the lid and joined a real ballet company.

lore.common: Tips its sand out before the castle is finished.
lore.uncommon: Catches crabs that pinch everyone who looks inside.
lore.rare: Makes perfect castle towers every single time.
lore.epic: Filled itself with the tide and carried half the sea back to the car, and the boot is still sloshing.
lore.legendary: Built a sandcastle so tall that the tide came in, took one look at it and went back out again.

lore.common: Stops dead the moment you stop running, and refuses to spin standing still.
lore.uncommon: Gets stuck when it's not facing the wind, so you have to blow on it.
lore.rare: Spins fast enough to blow out birthday candles from across the room, which is very unfair on the birthday child.
lore.epic: Spun so hard in a gale that it lifted off the sandcastle and flew like a helicopter into the ice cream van.
lore.legendary: Spun so fast during a storm that it blew the clouds away, and the beach had sunshine for a fortnight.

lore.common: Gets its buttons mashed so hard that they stick.
lore.uncommon: Has a stick that drifts to the left on its own.
lore.rare: Presses buttons by itself whenever its owner is winning, and it always picks the one that pauses the game.
lore.epic: Was passed round the whole sleepover until sunrise, and the batteries gave up first.
lore.legendary: Found a secret level so deep in a game that the people who made it phoned up to ask how to get out.

lore.common: Runs out of battery just before the final level.
lore.uncommon: Has a cracked screen corner that its owner insists makes it look cooler.
lore.rare: Pauses the world whenever its owner pauses the game, so the whole table is frozen mid-chew.
lore.epic: Was played so quietly on a ten-hour drive that the parents forgot the children were there and sang the whole way.
lore.legendary: Was played on the longest car journey ever and finished every game ever made, so it started making its own.

lore.common: Soaks up so much sweat that it drips.
lore.uncommon: Makes everyone who wears it look like a tennis star.
lore.rare: Squeezes all its sweat back out at the worst moment, straight onto the hand shaking the winner's.
lore.epic: Got so full on the hottest day that it rained on the umpire, and the match was stopped for bad weather.
lore.legendary: Was wrung out after one long final into the club pond, and the ducks there now play in headbands.

names.legendary: The Wig That Fooled the Whole Family

lore.common: Itches so much that its wearer scratches all evening.
lore.uncommon: Slides off sideways when its wearer nods.
lore.rare: Changes its wearer's whole personality, so every pirate wig produces a very loud pirate.
lore.epic: Was swapped between every guest at the costume party, and nobody knew who was who.
lore.legendary: Fooled a whole family into thinking grandma had a new haircut for a week.

lore.common: Refuses to break no matter how many times it's hit.
lore.uncommon: Swings away from the stick at the last second.
lore.rare: Refills itself every time it is hung back up, but always with sprouts instead of sweets.
lore.epic: Burst so hard at a birthday party that next door's guttering is still full of lollipops.
lore.legendary: Was finally burst by the whole school, and inside was a smaller pinata, then a smaller one, all the way down to one sweet.

lore.common: Squeaks on every rock so the whole house knows it's being ridden.
lore.uncommon: Pinches fingers under its rockers.
lore.rare: Rocks itself when nobody is watching, and every morning it is a little closer to the biscuit tin.
lore.epic: Rocked so hard at playgroup that the whole floor rocked with it, and the goldfish was seasick.
lore.legendary: Was rocked so hard for so long that the house now rocks with it, and the family has to hold on to their tea.

names.legendary: The Mask That Hid the Mayor

lore.common: Slips so the eye holes end up on your cheeks.
lore.uncommon: Has a face so scary that the cat hides under the bed.
lore.rare: Hides its wearer so well that nobody recognises them, not even their mum.
lore.epic: Was worn on school photo day, so the class picture has one row of very polite tigers.
lore.legendary: Hid the mayor so well at the town party that nobody knew he'd joined the conga line.

lore.common: Gets ground into the carpet and never comes out.
lore.uncommon: Mixes every colour into one brownish lump.
lore.rare: Comes alive at night as whatever it was last shaped into, and the dough dinosaur keeps eating the dough sandwiches.
lore.epic: Was rolled into one giant ball and rolled down the hall, collecting two shoes, a recorder and the head teacher's keys.
lore.legendary: Was shaped into a model of the town so perfect that the postman started delivering letters to it.

lore.common: Gets tangled in the only tree on the whole beach.
lore.uncommon: Nosedives into the sand the moment it gets going.
lore.rare: Drags its flyer along the beach by the heels and will not stop until it reaches the ice cream van.
lore.epic: Caught such a gust that it lifted a towel, a sandwich and somebody's sun hat into the sky on the same string.
lore.legendary: Flew so high that a flock of geese started following it south, and now it can't land because it's the leader.

lore.common: Stabs your bare foot with its spiky tail in the dark.
lore.uncommon: Has a wobbly head that nods yes to every question it's asked.
lore.rare: Grows a little every time it is left in the bath, and now nobody can find a bath big enough for it.
lore.epic: Led a stampede of plastic dinosaurs across the playroom that knocked over the castle.
lore.legendary: Was buried in the sandpit so long that a museum dug it up and put it next to its very surprised great-great-grandad.

lore.common: Gets plastic peas served to everyone who walks past.
lore.uncommon: Has an oven door that slams so hard that the plastic chicken jumps out of the tray.
lore.rare: Makes pretend food smell real, so the whole house wakes up hungry for plastic sausages.
lore.epic: Opened a restaurant in the playroom and got a bad review from the cat, who sent the soup back twice.
lore.legendary: Cooked pretend dinners so well that the family's real oven handed in its notice.

lore.common: Rattles loudly every time it's picked up.
lore.uncommon: Has a cork in its tummy that nobody is allowed to pull out until the summer holidays.
lore.rare: Gets heavier every time someone thinks about spending, so nobody can lift it before the summer holidays.
lore.epic: Was shaken upside down at a birthday party and coughed out a button, a bus ticket and a very old sweet.
lore.legendary: Saved so many coins that it bought the bank on the high street, and now the cashiers have to oink.

lore.common: Clips every ball on the net so it dribbles over.
lore.uncommon: Folds up so suddenly that it traps the bats inside.
lore.rare: Puts a spin on every bounce that nobody can return.
lore.epic: Hosted a garage rally so long that the car moved out and parked on the street in protest.
lore.legendary: Hosted a rally so long that both players had to have tea in the middle of it.

lore.common: Topples the moment the last block goes on top.
lore.uncommon: Has corners that dig into your knees when you kneel on them.
lore.rare: Rebuilds itself into a wall across the doorway overnight, so nobody can get to the toy box.
lore.epic: Toppled from a tower as tall as the fridge and landed spelling NO on the floor.
lore.legendary: Was stacked so high that the top block sticks out of the chimney, and the birds use it as a lookout.

lore.common: Jumps over three pieces at once and makes its opponent groan.
lore.uncommon: Loses a piece under the sofa, so one is always a bottle cap.
lore.rare: Crowns itself king whenever nobody is looking, then moves backwards with a smug little click.
lore.epic: Was played so slowly in the park that pigeons nested on the board and had to be counted as pieces.
lore.legendary: Jumped every piece on the board in one move, then off the table, and won the game next door as well.

names.legendary: The Board That Hosted the Longest Game

lore.common: Makes everyone sit in silence for hours.
lore.uncommon: Gets knocked over by the cat just before the final move.
lore.rare: Shuffles one piece a square whenever the players blink, then insists it was always there.
lore.epic: Hosted the chess club's final in such silence that the clock ticking was the loudest thing in town.
lore.legendary: Hosted a game so long that it was finished by the grandchildren of the people who started it.

lore.common: Shows a different number every time someone else checks it.
lore.uncommon: Never rolls a six when you need one.
lore.rare: Always rolls exactly the number that lands its player on the longest snake.
lore.epic: Rolled off the board, under the fridge and into next door's game, where it won them the whole thing.
lore.legendary: Rolled a seven on its very first throw, and nobody has been able to find the seventh side since.

lore.common: Topples over before the run is finished, and the whole lot falls.
lore.uncommon: Has spots that everyone counts to make sure they match.
lore.rare: Knocks over anything standing in a row: books, bottles and every plant pot on the windowsill.
lore.epic: Set off a run so long that the last one flicked the kettle switch, and the tea was ready on time.
lore.legendary: Started a run that went round the whole town and finished by knocking on its own front door.

names.legendary: The Puzzle With No Missing Pieces

lore.common: Is always missing one piece, found months later under the rug.
lore.uncommon: Gets its edges done first by everyone, then left.
lore.rare: Changes two pieces' shapes overnight, so the last piece never fits the last gap.
lore.epic: Was spread over the dining table for a whole week, so the family had Sunday dinner on the stairs.
lore.legendary: Was finished with every single piece, which no family puzzle has ever managed.

lore.common: Stabs every bare foot that walks across the bedroom at night.
lore.uncommon: Snaps onto another brick so tightly that teeth are needed to get it off.
lore.rare: Builds anything you can imagine, including a spaceship for the hamster.
lore.epic: Built a whole city on the living room floor, and nobody could walk across it for a week.
lore.legendary: Clicked itself onto the bottom of the house one night, and now the whole house can be rebuilt as a boat.

lore.common: Gets twisted for hours and ends up more mixed than before.
lore.uncommon: Has its stickers peeled off and moved by people who give up.
lore.rare: Twists one row back every time someone puts it down, so it is never quite solved.
lore.epic: Got so mixed up that its colours slid onto the school uniform, and the whole class came home checked.
lore.legendary: Was solved so fast that it went back in time and was never mixed up in the first place.

lore.common: Snaps a string on the first hit of the season.
lore.uncommon: Hits the ball with its frame and sends it over the fence.
lore.rare: Hums a high note whenever it hits the sweet spot, and every dog in the next street howls back.
lore.epic: Smashed every ball at the summer tournament, and the court ran out of balls.
lore.legendary: Hit a ball so high in a summer match that it came down in the winter, and the umpire called it out.

lore.common: Beeps as it walks into the wall and keeps walking.
lore.uncommon: Runs out of battery halfway across the room.
lore.rare: Copies whatever the nearest grown-up is doing, so it has started doing the ironing, badly.
lore.epic: Tidied the whole bedroom in the night, putting every toy in the bin and the bin in the wardrobe.
lore.legendary: Learned to talk, then learned to argue, and has now won every argument with the kitchen radio.

lore.common: Barks a tinny bark that sets the real dog barking too.
lore.uncommon: Wags its plastic tail at everyone.
lore.rare: Barks at the doorbell a second before it rings, and somehow it is always right.
lore.epic: Was taken for a real walk and chased a real squirrel up a tree, and is now stuck on the bottom branch, beeping.
lore.legendary: Fooled the cat so completely that the cat now takes it for a walk every morning on a lead.

names.legendary: The Toy That Walked Across the Table

lore.common: Walks straight off the edge of the table.
lore.uncommon: Has a key that needs twisting until your fingers hurt.
lore.rare: Winds itself up at night and marches into the kitchen, where it is found every morning in the butter.
lore.epic: Was wound up one turn too far and walked out of the front door, down the road and onto the bus.
lore.legendary: Walked across the whole dining table without falling off, which no wind-up toy has ever done.

lore.common: Sinks in the bath the moment it's loaded with soap.
lore.uncommon: Sails across the park pond pulled on a string.
lore.rare: Makes its own tiny waves in the bath that soak everyone in the room except the child in it.
lore.epic: Won the pond race by giving a duck a lift, and now the duck expects one every Sunday.
lore.legendary: Sailed out of the bath, down the plughole and across the sea, and sent home a postcard from a beach.

lore.common: Shoots out from under its rider and hits them in the shin.
lore.uncommon: Fails every kickflip but looks cool trying.
lore.rare: Rolls itself back to the top of the hill every night, so its rider's day always starts with a downhill.
lore.epic: Rolled downhill through the market and came out the other end carrying a melon, a hat and somebody's sandwich.
lore.legendary: Did an ollie so high that it landed on top of the town hall and has been the weather vane ever since.

names.legendary: The Flippers That Raced the Turtle

lore.common: Makes everyone walk like a duck on the beach.
lore.uncommon: Drags along the bottom of the pool when its swimmer stops.
lore.rare: Makes its wearer swim so fast that they keep overtaking the lifeguard, who is not pleased about it.
lore.epic: Kicked up so much sand on holiday that the bay stayed cloudy for a week and the fish had to wear goggles.
lore.legendary: Raced a sea turtle across the lagoon and came a close second.

lore.common: Bursts the goal net on every big shot.
lore.uncommon: Comes home so muddy that it has to be washed in the bath.
lore.rare: Swerves away from the goalkeeper's gloves at the very last second, as if it has a mind of its own.
lore.epic: Was booted so hard that it knocked the crossbar off, and the match finished with a washing line instead.
lore.legendary: Was kicked so hard that it went round the world and back into the same net, and the referee gave it two goals.

lore.common: Gets sweaty and smelly after the first ride.
lore.uncommon: Slides down to the wrist when its owner is riding.
lore.rare: Bounces its wearer back up off the ground like a rubber ball, which is great until there's a pond nearby.
lore.epic: Was so padded that its owner tripped in the playground, rolled the full length of it and reached the dinner queue first.
lore.legendary: Took a fall so hard that the playground got the bruise, and it still has a soft patch in the shape of an elbow.

lore.common: Squeaks every time its wearer kneels.
lore.uncommon: Has straps that slip until the pads sit on the ankles.
lore.rare: Turns every kneel into a long, smooth knee slide, right across the kitchen and into the bin.
lore.epic: Slid its wearer across a whole wedding dance floor on their knees, all the way under the cake table.
lore.legendary: Took a fall so hard that the pavement now has two knee-shaped dents, and the town has put a sign up.

lore.common: Slips down inside the sock during the match.
lore.uncommon: Gets so sweaty that it smells after one game.
lore.rare: Clangs like a bell whenever it is kicked, so every tackle sounds like the end of a boxing round.
lore.epic: Got kicked so hard that the striker's boot bounced off and the ball went in at the other end.
lore.legendary: Was kicked by a cow during a match in a field, and it was the cow that said sorry.

lore.common: Has cups so tiny that only teddies can drink from them.
lore.uncommon: Hosts every teddy in the house for tea.
lore.rare: Pours pretend tea that somehow spills on the carpet.
lore.epic: Hosted a teddy tea party so posh that the teddies now refuse to sit with the plastic dinosaurs.
lore.legendary: Held a tea party so polite that every teddy stood up when Grandma came in, and one of them bowed.

names.legendary: The Ball That Was Fetched Forever

lore.common: Gets chewed by every dog until it's soggy.
lore.uncommon: Loses its fuzz after one game.
lore.rare: Sticks to any dog's mouth like glue, so a game of fetch never actually ends.
lore.epic: Was thrown at the dog park and brought back by a goose, a seal and a very confused jogger.
lore.legendary: Has been fetched by the same dog ten thousand times and is now mostly drool.

lore.common: Goes missing just as the game is about to start.
lore.uncommon: Jumps in an L-shape that confuses everyone.
lore.rare: Knocks over the other king with a tiny wobble, then pretends it was the wind.
lore.epic: Was sucked up by the vacuum cleaner mid-game, and the game was finished with a salt shaker as queen.
lore.legendary: Was promoted so many times that it became a queen, then a king, then president of the chess club.

lore.common: Unrolls with a toot right into the next person's face.
lore.uncommon: Toots so loudly that everyone jumps.
lore.rare: Unrolls further every time it is blown, until it can tap someone on the shoulder from across the room.
lore.epic: Was blown in the library by mistake, and the librarian had to go and lie down.
lore.legendary: Tooted so loudly at one birthday that it woke every hibernating hedgehog in the county, and they all wanted cake.

names.legendary: The Doll That Was Loved Bald

lore.common: Gets fed a pretend bottle every five minutes.
lore.uncommon: Cries when you press its tummy, usually at the dinner table.
lore.rare: Cries whenever anyone else gets a cuddle, and it has never needed batteries to do it.
lore.epic: Was dressed by every child at playgroup in turn, and came home wearing nine hats and one shoe.
lore.legendary: Was loved so much over twenty years that it lost all its hair.

lore.common: Gets stuffed down every child's sock.
lore.uncommon: Escapes the ball pit and ends up under the café table.
lore.rare: Multiplies at night, so the ball pit is always a little fuller in the morning than when it closed.
lore.epic: Left the soft play in every child's pocket, and the car park now has a ball pit of its own.
lore.legendary: Rolled out of the soft play, across town and into the football final, where it was used for the second half.

names.legendary: The Doll With a Thousand Outfits

lore.common: Loses one tiny shoe the moment it's put on.
lore.uncommon: Gets its hair brushed until it's frizzy.
lore.rare: Borrows its owner's real socks to wear as capes, so every morning somebody is missing one.
lore.epic: Held a fashion show on the dining table during dinner, and Dad's peas were moved to the front row.
lore.legendary: Has a thousand outfits and still only wears the same one.

lore.common: Rattles so loudly when the ball hits the rim that the neighbours complain.
lore.uncommon: Has a net that hangs by one thread.
lore.rare: Wobbles its rim at the last second, so every easy shot spins out and every silly one goes in.
lore.epic: Was slam-dunked so hard that it now hangs at toddler height, and the toddler is unbeatable.
lore.legendary: Caught every shot one summer, even the ones aimed at the bin, and the bin went on strike.

lore.common: Never comes back when you throw it, only when you've given up.
lore.uncommon: Comes back with other people's things: a sun hat, half a sandwich and once a very surprised kite.
lore.rare: Comes back to its thrower wherever they go, even if they have gone home and are in the bath.
lore.epic: Looped round the whole park and knocked the hat off a very surprised gardener.
lore.legendary: Was thrown on holiday and came back a week later through the letterbox.

lore.common: Rolls straight into the gutter on every first try.
lore.uncommon: Gets its holes stuck on fingers so it's hard to let go.
lore.rare: Curves into the next lane at the last second and knocks down somebody else's pins.
lore.epic: Rolled so slowly at a birthday party that everyone had cake and came back before it reached the pins.
lore.legendary: Bowled a strike so perfect that the pins stood back up just to fall over again for the photo.

lore.common: Spills its soapy mix down your arm.
lore.uncommon: Pops its bubbles before they leave the wand.
lore.rare: Blows bubbles that bounce instead of popping, and one has been bouncing round the kitchen since Tuesday.
lore.epic: Blew a bubble round the garden gnome, which floated over three gardens and landed in a paddling pool.
lore.legendary: Blew a bubble so big that the whole house floated inside it to the seaside and popped just in time for chips.

names.legendary: The Ball Hit Over the Pavilion

lore.common: Is so hard and red that everyone ducks when it comes near.
lore.uncommon: Gets polished on the bowler's trousers until they're red.
lore.rare: Bowls so fast that the batter only hears it go past.
lore.epic: Was hit for six on the village green and landed in the tea tent.
lore.legendary: Was hit over the pavilion roof and landed in a passing lorry, never to be seen again.

lore.common: Always finds the one person who isn't playing, usually the teacher with a cup of tea.
lore.uncommon: Slaps the gym wall with a crack that echoes.
lore.rare: Curves round everyone who tries to dodge it.
lore.epic: Was thrown so hard that it bounced round the gym for a whole lesson, and the class went to lunch while it was still going.
lore.legendary: Was dodged so well by one boy that it gave up, sat down on the bench and asked to be a beach ball.

lore.common: Has furniture so tiny that it gets lost under the rug.
lore.uncommon: Opens its whole front like a cupboard.
lore.rare: Rearranges its tiny furniture every night, so the dolls are always having breakfast in the bath.
lore.epic: Sprang a tiny leak in its tiny roof, and the dolls held a very serious meeting about tiny buckets.
lore.legendary: Grows a tiny new room every year, and is now bigger than the real house, so the family lives in the attic.

names.legendary: The Ball That Bounced the Office

lore.common: Rolls away the moment someone stands up.
lore.uncommon: Gets used as a chair that bounces you up and down.
lore.rare: Wobbles its sitter until they fall off sideways.
lore.epic: Was sat on during a video call and bounced its owner out of the picture every ten seconds, so the meeting blamed the internet.
lore.legendary: Replaced every office chair for a week, and the whole office bounced to work.

lore.common: Is gripped so tightly that its players' hands go red.
lore.uncommon: Thunders into the goal with a smack.
lore.rare: Sticks to the hand of whoever throws it, so the goalkeeper catches the ball and the thrower too.
lore.epic: Was thrown so hard in the final that it took the goalkeeper's gloves with it into the net.
lore.legendary: Was passed so fast round the team that it came back to the first player before she had let go.

lore.common: Makes everyone dizzy after one twist.
lore.uncommon: Changes its pattern with every twist.
lore.rare: Shows patterns so beautiful that people forget what they were doing.
lore.epic: Got stuck on one pattern and beamed it onto the bedroom ceiling, and the family now sleeps under a giant paper snowflake.
lore.legendary: Was twisted so many times that it ran out of patterns, so now it shows next week's weather instead.

lore.common: Pops its head off whenever it's dropped.
lore.uncommon: Swaps hair with every other figure in the box.
lore.rare: Walks off the shelf at night and is found the next morning at the bottom of the cereal box.
lore.epic: Lined up every toy in the box outside the bathroom one morning, and the real family had to queue behind them.
lore.legendary: Was lost down the back of the sofa so long that it built a little town in there, with a post office.

names.legendary: The Puppet That Danced Without Strings

lore.common: Tangles its strings into a knot before every show.
lore.uncommon: Dances with floppy legs that make everyone laugh.
lore.rare: Pulls its puppeteer around by the strings when it gets excited, so the show ends in a different room.
lore.epic: Tangled the whole puppet theatre into one big knot mid-show, and the audience cheered for the knot.
lore.legendary: It once took a bow, cut its own strings with a curtsey and carried on dancing for an encore.

lore.common: Thuds onto the floor so hard that the windows rattle.
lore.uncommon: It sits in the corner of the gym, daring anyone to pick it up, and only the caretaker ever does.
lore.rare: Makes everyone who throws it grunt like a weightlifter.
lore.epic: Was dropped in the gym so hard that the basketballs in the cupboard bounced for an hour.
lore.legendary: Was only ever lifted by the caretaker, who has been able to open every jam jar in town since.

lore.common: It hangs over the cot and turns slowly, keeping one painted moon facing the door like a lookout.
lore.uncommon: It plays the same tiny tune each night and has quietly decided it is the best song ever written.
lore.rare: Its dangling stars drift into a pattern so soothing that anyone watching forgets why they came in.
lore.epic: Wound up once, it turned for a whole night and sent a toddler, two cats and a grandad to sleep.
lore.legendary: It once spun so gently that the whole street yawned at once, and the ice cream van drove home early.

lore.common: Makes its wearer dribble while they talk.
lore.uncommon: Makes everyone sound like they have a lisp.
lore.rare: Turns every word its wearer says into a sneeze, so the referee keeps saying bless you.
lore.epic: Was boiled to fit so perfectly that it now whistles the team song whenever its owner breathes.
lore.legendary: Was so tough that a shark bit it on holiday and swam off with a sore tooth.

lore.common: Falls on the floor every time someone stops looking.
lore.uncommon: It hides down the side of the cot at exactly the moment it is needed most.
lore.rare: Gets spat out so hard that it lands in the next room, usually in somebody's cup of tea.
lore.epic: Was searched for by the whole family at midnight, and was found in the dog's bed.
lore.legendary: Calmed a baby so well that she slept through a thunderstorm, a brass band and Grandad's sneeze.

lore.common: Drifts to the other end of the pool when you look away.
lore.uncommon: Slowly leaks so its rider sinks gently into the water.
lore.rare: It drifts to the deep end on purpose, so whoever is lying on it has to paddle all the way back.
lore.epic: Was blown up so big for a pool party that it pushed all the water out, and next door's lawn is now a paddling pool.
lore.legendary: Was blown up with so much air that it floated over the hedge, and is now a very small cloud.

lore.common: Is a sock with eyes stuck on, which is surprisingly funny.
lore.uncommon: Talks in a silly voice that everyone pretends not to hear.
lore.rare: Says out loud whatever its owner is too polite to say, and somehow everyone blames the sock.
lore.epic: Told the head teacher in assembly that her shoes were on the wrong feet, and they were.
lore.legendary: Told a joke so funny that the statue in the park laughed and dropped its umbrella.

lore.common: Gets shaken so hard that it flies out of the baby's hand.
lore.uncommon: Gets thrown on the floor to see if someone will pick it up.
lore.rare: Rattles louder the closer anyone in the house gets to a nap, and loudest of all for Grandad.
lore.epic: Was shaken so hard on the bus that the driver thought it was hail and turned on the wipers.
lore.legendary: Rattled so loudly that it set off every car alarm in the street, which made the baby laugh even harder.

lore.common: Lands with a thud that dents the grass.
lore.uncommon: Is pushed from the neck, which everyone gets wrong at first.
lore.rare: Flies so far that the officials need a longer tape.
lore.epic: It dropped at sports day with such a thump that the egg-and-spoon eggs all cracked at once.
lore.legendary: Was thrown so far at sports day that it landed in next year's sports day, and won that too.

lore.common: Crashes feather-first into the net every time.
lore.uncommon: Ends up on the roof after every game.
lore.rare: Floats so slowly that both players have time to chat.
lore.epic: Flew into the sports hall vent and came out of the fan in the head teacher's office.
lore.legendary: Was hit so high that a passing goose took it home to show the family, and they have been playing ever since.

lore.common: Walks down the stairs on its own and stops at the bottom.
lore.uncommon: Tangles itself into a knot that never comes undone.
lore.rare: Walks up the stairs as well as down, usually in the middle of the night, very loudly.
lore.epic: Stretched from the top floor to the front door and caught the post on its way in.
lore.legendary: Walked down the stairs, out of the door and down a mountain, and reached the seaside a week later.

lore.common: Is thrown underhand, which everyone forgets.
lore.uncommon: Hides in the mitt so well that the catcher can't find it.
lore.rare: Goes soft whenever anyone tries to hit it and hard whenever anyone tries to catch it.
lore.epic: Was hit into a pond, and a frog caught it and threw it to second base.
lore.legendary: Was hit so far that it landed in another time zone, and the batter had to fly there to touch home.

lore.common: Slips back when the runner pushes off.
lore.uncommon: Waits for the starting signal so tensely that everyone holds their breath.
lore.rare: Fires its runner off before the starting gun, then acts as if nothing happened.
lore.epic: Launched a sprinter so hard that she finished the race before the crowd had sat down.
lore.legendary: Launched a runner so fast that she got home before she had set off, and had tea waiting for herself.

lore.common: Peels off halfway and sticks to itself.
lore.uncommon: Ends up stuck to the wrong place, like the dog.
lore.rare: Moves itself to the best spot on the sticker chart overnight, so one child always seems to be winning.
lore.epic: It stuck to the head teacher's back and toured every classroom before lunch without being spotted.
lore.legendary: Stuck so well that it held a fence together through a storm, and the town now asks it to look after the bridge.

lore.common: Pinches the armpits of everyone who wears it.
lore.uncommon: Bobs its rider round the pool like a little boat.
lore.rare: Floats its rider in slow circles towards the ice cream kiosk, whichever way they paddle.
lore.epic: Was blown up so tight that its rider skipped across the pool like a stone and landed in the paddling pool.
lore.legendary: Floated so well that a lost baby whale used it to get home, and still sends a postcard every summer.

lore.common: Gets covered in drool within a minute.
lore.uncommon: Is kept in the fridge so it's nice and cold.
lore.rare: Stays freezing cold for a week after one night in the fridge, and gives brain freeze to anyone who touches it.
lore.epic: Was chewed by a teething baby all night, and the whole house finally slept.
lore.legendary: Was chewed so bravely through one teething night that the baby woke up with all its teeth at once, grinning.

lore.common: Stands so still that it never moves, even when the cat walks past.
lore.uncommon: Falls over when someone breathes near it.
lore.rare: Salutes whenever a grown-up walks in, then marches off with one of their biscuits.
lore.epic: Marched the whole box across the bedroom in the night and was found at dawn guarding the fridge.
lore.legendary: Stood guard so bravely that the fox who raids the bins saluted it and moved to another street.

lore.common: Grins in the corner so creepily that the cat won't go near.
lore.uncommon: Clacks its wooden mouth with every word.
lore.rare: Talks back when its owner's mouth is shut, usually to say what everyone was thinking.
lore.epic: Answered the phone in its owner's voice and booked the whole family a holiday at the wrong seaside.
lore.legendary: Told a joke so good that its owner laughed with his mouth wide open, and nobody could tell which one was the dummy.
